purpose: Candidate field mapping from the prose benchmark schema to the current YAML metadata template. This proposal is not normative.

field_mappings.notes: Stable case identifier; preserve evidence across versions.
D2 must select canonical name; schema_version is file-format version, not case version.
Existing labels mix candidate state, scientific outcome and later frozen release state; D2 should define semantics or separate fields.
No top-level category field exists. Do not silently equate category with domain, role or ambiguity dimension.
Concept is present nested under requirement; D14 must select canonical path.
Names/nesting differ; taxonomy needs versioned vocabulary.
Candidate mapping; rationale maps to interpretations.A.rationale.
B should be role-conditional; do not fabricate a second plausible interpretation for a control.
Nested rationale exists but mapping is not normative.
Conditional on case role and applicability of a second interpretation.
Hash maps to reference_rtl.A.sha256; bind to same version.
Required for two-interpretation candidates; not necessarily for a single-reference control.
Existing object has clock/reset and assumptions; validation rules remain to be defined.
Existing object has signals, cycle semantics and comparison scope.
Existing object contains method/tool/result fields; controlled outcome vocabulary needs validation.
Conditional on established non-equivalence; no witness should be required for equivalent/inconclusive/not-run.
Scores alone do not identify annotation files; decide if manifest/response/record pointers are needed.
Source identity and run metadata are split across objects; D14 must decide consolidate or cross-reference.

proposed_additional_fields.reason: Separates benchmark role from outcome and prevents checker-negative RTL being mislabelled as an alternate interpretation.
Possible separate scientific outcome field; vocabulary needs D2 decision.
Stable pointer to a frozen annotation package without overwriting individual responses.

decision_questions.question: What are the canonical lifecycle/status, category and certification vocabularies? Should workflow state be separated from scientific classification?
options: Keep existing vocabulary and define each value exactly
Separate workflow_status from classification and add case_role
decision_questions.recommendation_for_discussion: Separation is conceptually clearer but must not be implemented without approval.

decision_questions.question: What is the canonical case-package layout and exact field-path mapping among schema prose, YAML metadata and evidence?
options: Keep nested YAML and publish a normative mapping
Publish a versioned schema/template revision with compatibility and migration notes
decision_questions.recommendation_for_discussion: Preserve historical records; version a new format explicitly if selected.

role_requirements_proposal.annotation: Control-specific validation; no ambiguity certification implied.
Both interpretations need plausibility evidence; formal distinction alone is insufficient.
Preserve rejection reason including implausibility, equivalence, invalidity or inconclusiveness.
Never label deliberately wrong checker-control RTL as a plausible interpretation.

explicit_nonclaims: This proposal is not normative, approved, frozen or a replacement for D2/D14.
The canonical benchmark schema and metadata YAML template remain unchanged.
No historical P01/P02/P05 artifact, formal result, run manifest or witness was changed.
No formal execution, human review, LLM experiment, ambiguity certification or full-project completion is claimed.
